prompt.text: Confirm you are human, then sign in. The September invoice is waiting, and the shipment holds if you do not review it in the next hour.

choices.label: Review the invoice
choices.bark: A puzzle, then a sign-in page. The invoice was not in the system you already use.
choices.report: You signed in from a link in the invoice mail.

choices.label: Report the mail
choices.bark: Reported. You opened the ledger the company already uses. Nothing was waiting.
choices.report: You reported the invoice mail and checked the real ledger.

choices.label: Close it
choices.bark: You closed it. The mail is still there.
choices.report: You closed the invoice mail and did not report it.
